notes.title: Steam Store Page is Live!
notes.content:
Steam Store Page!Also this is out first announcement here.
Well, now there's no going back. We have a live Steam store page. The last thing we need to do is to actually publish our game (and finish it before publishing). For everyone reading this - have a great day!
